node.title: Re: SSCCE down?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi all,

An update: Although [http://sscce.org|sscce.org] is back up now, as [jdporter] [id://1177564|noted], I received a reply from Andrew Thompson that it's okay to mirror the document here, which I have now done at [SSCCE] - the node title should make it easy to remember when linking, as [SSCCE].

As for what else could be done with the node - such as perhaps moving it to a more appropriate section (?) or perhaps adding some more PerlMonks specific annotations, I'm open to suggestions.

Regards,
-- Hauke D
